neighbours.label: anaphoric 'the same' standing in for an action or thing already named (do the same, the same was filed) and 'followed suit', as against 'same' as an adjective before a noun
fire: Her brother quit sugar in January, and she soon did the same.
One bank raised its rates, and the others quickly followed suit.
If your neighbors recycle, you should probably do the same.
When the captain stood up, the whole team did the same.
The first shop closed early, and the rest of the street followed suit.
My friend planted tomatoes, so this year I will do the same.
After the singer bowed, the band members did the same.
When one school banned phones, several others followed suit.
quiet: Her brother quit sugar in January, and she quit on the same day.
One bank raised its rates, and the others kept the same rates.
If your neighbors recycle, you probably live on the same street.
When the captain stood up, the whole team wore the same shirts.
The first shop closed early, and the rest of the street stayed open.
My friend planted tomatoes in the same bed as last year.
After the singer bowed, the band members played the same song again.
When one school banned phones, several others banned the same apps.
